en|bac06cd5e7de: Caribbean shake guaranteed with bouyon, shatta and baile funk in Cannes.
en|569ed644a414: The Skyfall club in Cannes hosts the Isla Tropical party to heat up the night. Guest and resident DJs will blast an explosive mix of shatta, bouyon, baile funk and afrobeats. The kickoff is at midnight for an intense dance session. Club entry tickets on sale from €10.
en|71d810c4906e: Off‑beat Christmas spirit and hip‑hop beats with your feet in the sand.
en|8185373f1ce8: Live house and oriental percussion at the Flèche Klub of Fort Napoléon.
en|f730cf227245: Third installment of Sisters Of Sand at Fort Napoléon for a journey mixing electronic and oriental sounds. Find _ORBE and Stella Yme on the decks, joined live by Zahi and Rinato on acoustic percussion. The indoor format takes over Bar Central and Flèche Klub from 7 pm to 1 am. Pre‑sales start at €5.99.
en|6ab2053ad68c: Over 50 artists on stage to relive disco and funk anthems at Estérel Aréna.
en|caf39b39d2e6: Estérel Aréna turns into a giant dancefloor to dive back into the 70s‑80s disco‑funk era. More than 50 musicians and artists will take the stage live and in mix to get the crowd moving. Aperitif bar and pizza food service on site from 7 pm to 11:30 pm. Tickets are available from €15 for this big retro‑covered night.
en|0d17f9479fdf: The ultra‑hot R&B and trap‑soul show by Dakeez lands in Nice at Frigo 16.
en|847473c2dafa: Franco‑Italian singer‑dancer Dakeez storms the stage at Frigo 16 for an ultra‑modern urban show. Mixing sensual trap‑soul vibes with dynamic hip‑hop rhythms, the artist promises a real vocal and visual showcase. Meet him at 109 in Nice from 8 pm to discover this rising phenomenon. Entry tickets start at €23.50.
en|84b003e3d6d0: Festive groove and house with Nice DJ Trvchi – free entry.
en|36503aed81bc: Enjoy your Saturday night at Mama Shelter Nice with a DJ set by Renaud aka Trvchi, a staple of the Azure nights for 18 years. He’ll spin house‑filled and groove‑heavy tracks so you can sip a drink and move at your own pace. Join from 8:30 pm to midnight at the hotel bar. Admission is completely free.
en|d2f1201a47b4: DJ booth in the middle of the room and a neorave deluge at Altherax.
en|60977dc85af2: Altherax Music hosts a new edition of its Boiler 360° format with the DJ set up in the centre of the dancefloor. Expect violent kicks, neorave and hard bounce delivered by several emerging hard‑techno DJs. A raw‑warehouse vibe guaranteed from 10 pm till the end of the night. Pre‑sales are €20.90.
en|0383294410dd: Total immersion in dark, punchy techno with the Ohm Family crew.
en|a16e0a2fde44: L'Antre gives free rein to the Ohm Family crew to turn the Vieux-Nice club into a true underground rave. The collective's DJs will take turns delivering dynamic sets that swing between precise hardgroove and cutting techno. Friendly vibe guaranteed from 10 PM to 2:30 AM with the sound system turned up to max. Tickets on site or pre‑sale for €5.
en|6adad005507b: Pure reggaeton and urban Latino madness takes over Frigo 16 in Nice.
en|a0d8a06f51fc: Parisian crew Mamacita returns to Nice for a third scorching edition at Frigo 16. On the program: a perreo clubbing night and urban music with DJs Driver MC, Kana J and ATNN. Expect a wave of reggaeton, dembow, shatta and baile funk to dance until the early hours. Doors open at 11:30 PM with pre‑sales starting at €13.70 online. Free shuttles connect Nice city centre to 109.
en|e28c7a6f7170: Psychedelic immersion and massive sound system at Switch Club.
en|c8182b94f07f: Switch Club goes full psychedelic with its Switch Dimension dedicated to psytrance and progressive beats. The line‑up brings together Hug'ette from the Les Tocards collective, Ranyo and producer AlesK to take you on a journey until dawn. Meet up in the Var from 11:30 PM to 5:30 AM for an intense visual and sonic experience. Online pre‑sales from €14.99.
en|654e92ec1ccd: All the classics from La Fouine in an intimate showcase at Sky Club.
en|252b0096f624: Living legend of French rap, La Fouine lands at the Sky Club in Casino de Beaulieu for an exceptional clubbing showcase. Come sing his classics and bangers in an intimate waterfront setting. Resident DJs will spin hip‑hop and afro sets from 11:30 PM. Smart dress code required, tickets available from €19.
en|47c692f18d78: Saturday night highlights urban and club sounds at High Club with the Bad Girls event. Resident DJs take over the decks to spin the best hip‑hop, contemporary RnB and reggaeton tracks on a powerful sound system. Doors open at midnight for an all‑night party until sunrise by the sea.
en|c94d4f05fdd1: PLK lands a massive concert at Palais Nikaïa as part of his big‑venue tour. The Parisian rapper promises a scorching vibe with trap bangers and must‑hear hits in front of thousands of fans. Doors open at 5:30 PM for a show starting at 7:00 PM. Choose between the standing pit for moshing or numbered seated tiers from €45. The venue is easily reachable via tram lines 2 and 3.
en|4de81bb25930: Intense Caribbean vibe with the Bobar crew at Factory La Farlède.
en|84ac1f837b72: Factory La Farlède hosts the Afrobbean night organized by the Bobar team for a festive, dance‑filled Sunday. Guest and resident DJs will make the speakers thump with the best shatta, bouyon and Caribbean dancehall. The session kicks off at 8 pm to close the weekend on a high‑energy tempo. Tickets from €10.
en|016af2a167f1: Pop‑electro night and nu‑disco DJ set for €5 flat at Stockfish.
en|b21f29ca7d84: Festive focus at Stockfish with a line‑up built for the student party crowd. The cult favorites Pony Pony Run Run will sing their electro‑pop anthems like “Hey You”, followed by producer Alastair Lane and his upbeat nu‑disco and house selection. The Nice venue opens at 8 pm with an unbeatable entry price of just €5. A perfect chance to dance without blowing your budget.
en|39f686057dbe: No‑holds‑barred night at High Club to dance with friends to all the party classics.
en|aebb5d9552d0: Want to cut the week off with your mates? High Club offers its Thursday night “Les Copains d'Abord”, designed for singing and vibing without any stress. The program: ultra‑festive resident set with pop anthems, dance hits and timeless tracks. The vibe kicks in at midnight with usually free entry at the start of the night.
en|2f08d147dcdf: Brodinski and Lariate Club fuse dark techno and trap at Frigo 16.
en|b1e7223f0a3f: Frigo 16 hosts Brodinski for a cutting‑edge club night around the release of the collective album Mono City. The Bromance label co‑founder will share the decks with Martynikefly, Tobhi.tm and the Lariate Club DJs. Expect a punchy hybrid rave mixing dark techno and club trap from 8 pm to 2 am. Tickets start at €15 early‑bird, with bar and food on site. Free shuttles run from Nice city centre.
en|777f06a8a7ab: Arabic House Night with Char Bell in the magical setting of Casino de Beaulieu.
en|542dbafc4bc8: The international Arabic House Night concept sets up shop in the sumptuous hall of Casino de Beaulieu. DJ and producer Char Bell takes the reins to blend traditional oriental percussion, afro house and contemporary electronic beats. Capacity is limited to 600 people from 9 pm to 2 am. Tickets from €19.99, smart‑casual dress code required.
en|db1fa301e6af: The official stop of the Shafro France Tour lands in Juan‑les‑Pins.
en|8207818bbc93: National phenomenon Shafro makes a stop at Honey Club for an explosive night mixing Caribbean shatta, dancehall and afrobeats. The tour’s official DJs will fire up the club to keep the crowd dancing until 5 am. Kick‑off at midnight in Juan‑les‑Pins. Club entry €10 with age check.
en|4d05f4919501: Big end‑of‑exams de‑compression party for Nice students at High Club.
en|cf8e2351fca7: When exams are over, Nice students and locals gather at High Club to unwind before the holidays. Residents will spin the biggest electro, urban and radio hits across the club’s rooms on the Promenade des Anglais. The night kicks off at midnight and runs until 5 a.m.
en|33cf05dac4b0: Three free DJ stages on the waterfront for partying at Bandol port.
en|cd5ce16a007d: Bandol’s quay turns into an open‑air dancefloor for the night. Three spaces, three different DJ vibes, dancing by the sea from 6 p.m. to 11 p.m. Free entry, with festive bars and Christmas‑village food stalls on site.
en|0b511a6999df: Free retro open‑air in the historic centre with 100 % 80s DJ sets.
en|a5d0ed77bf9b: Place Formigé becomes a huge open‑air dancefloor for an evening dedicated to classic 80s hits. DJ sets will spin pop‑rock, synth‑pop and disco from 6 p.m. to midnight. Retro looks are strongly encouraged to soak up the vibe and the tasty chalets nearby. Entry is completely free and open to everyone.
en|8b8fb568af9f: Massive vibrations and sound system culture at Frigo 16 with Mungo’s Hi Fi.
en|75fe9a31ff43: Scottish dub masters Mungo’s Hi Fi land at Frigo 16 for a heavy‑bass sound‑system session. Glasgow producers will share the bill with Red Echoes for a night swinging between bass music, reggae and electro rave. The party runs from 8 p.m. to 2 a.m. with standing sub‑woofers. Pre‑sales are €13.70, cashless on site. Free shuttles run from the city centre.
en|58d8a5b8a883: Enchanting soul concert with Tiwayo and Betsy Rose at Théâtre Denis.
en|c7813e2d8f28: The city of Hyères and Tandem invite soul singer Tiwayo, produced in the US by Adrián Quesada of Black Pumas. He shares the stage with artist Betsy Rose for a night of rhythm‑and‑blues and urban pop. Concert starts at 8:30 p.m. at Théâtre Denis, seated and standing. Tickets available via Tandem 83 from €12.
en|1e5e5ce93eee: Hard‑techno phenomenon VIDO lands at Switch Club in 360° format.
en|95f10c059fb2: Hard‑techno star VIDO, known from major stages like Tomorrowland Winter, sets up at Switch Club. He shares the bill with Furious.wav, NZØ b2b Odyze and TAO for a wave of hard‑techno kicks, bounce and 90s rave. Central 360° stage and XXL sound system run from 11:30 p.m. to 5:30 a.m. Pre‑sales start at €10.99 very early.
en|b5c8b2be6f49: High Club cranks up the high‑energy mode with its Take Control concept. Expect a flood of punchy drops, dynamic electro‑house and an immersive light show powered by the resident DJs on the Promenade des Anglais dancefloor. Doors open at midnight for a festive clubbing night until the early morning.
en|843344d34d8a: Free high‑octane heavy blues‑rock concert by the sea at the Grimaldi Forum.
en|12b695923a3a: The Grimaldi Forum hosts its free monthly live night in the Indigo space overlooking the Mediterranean. From 6:30 pm enjoy a warm‑up apéromix before Dirty Deep takes the stage at 8:30 pm. This French power‑trio will blast heavy blues and explosive garage rock led by Victor Sbrovazzo. Entry is completely free, drinks and food are paid on site.
en|398df7c75f66: All the Coldplay anthems performed live under Place du Casino at New Moods.
en|41a83fc36e0b: New Moods welcomes you under Café de Paris for an intimate club night from 7:30 pm to midnight. The band Coldshivers will hit the stage to cover Coldplay’s biggest pop‑rock hits in a venue limited to 320 spots. Tickets start at €65 and include the concert plus a minimum spend on finger food or drinks. A lounge vibe will take over for the late‑night chill.
en|fb718544b1a5: Neon Experience brings Ben Carter to Dix‑Huit for a punchy afro‑house and tech‑house set.
en|265a3fcd1d12: Skates, disco balls and free disco music at Frigo 16.
en|a84f4e29eb28: Panda Events turns Frigo 16 into a giant roller‑disco floor for a totally wild vintage night. Slip on your skates and dance under disco balls to a funky, nu‑disco and house selection spun by resident DJs. The event kicks off at 8 pm and entry is completely free, perfect for hanging out with friends before the year‑end parties.
en|8e2e6bba6ef7: Live percussion, tapas and afro‑oriental clubbing for the 2nd edition of NŌR in Antibes.
en|ae44f527b02d: The NŌR concept returns for a mesmerizing second edition at So Blue Hôtel Restaurant in Antibes. The night is split into two parts: a tapas aperitif with live percussion show from 7:30 pm, then a clubbing session until 1 am featuring afro‑house and oriental rhythms. A warm musical immersion by the Mediterranean. Early‑bird tickets start at €16.50.
en|bfb6ff9674c5: Nice’s young rap and urban pop guard takes over the stage at Dix‑Huit.
en|fea540bc128a: Come support the emerging local scene at Le Dix‑Huit club in Nice with a promising co‑lineup. You'll see Le Môme with his rap‑pop urban flow alongside Adamé and his nostalgic pop‑rock touches. The intimate venue guarantees maximum closeness to the artists for a lively, authentic concert. The show kicks off at 8:30 pm standing, with a bar on site. Tickets are available from €15.
en|0b777e95b765: 360° clubbing experience inspired by Boiler Rooms in La Valette.
en|ba1915ab66af: Dive into immersive clubbing with The Boiler R*** in La Valette-du-Var. The concept puts the DJ booth in the middle of the room with the crowd all around 360 degrees for total proximity to the artists. Var DJs spin house, afro house and tech house sets from 9 p.m. to 3 a.m. Entry tickets are 12 euros.
en|ddcd78a4b3f4: High Club kicks off the year‑end festivities with its themed More Than Dream night. Two rooms open their doors so you can switch between hot Latin rhythms and house or hip‑hop beats mixed by the residents. Detailed décor and a big light show await you from midnight to celebrate the start of holidays right in the heart of the Promenade des Anglais.
en|c1155ce0cb6a: Free festive electro open‑air party in the centre of Fréjus.
en|97856dad246b: Fréjus creates an outdoor clubbing vibe with the Electro Party DJ on Place Formigé. Several guest DJs take over the decks to drop heavy club house and dance tracks from 6 p.m. to midnight. Light animations accompany the party in the winter village. It’s the perfect free way to warm up a Saturday night with friends.
en|4434b78865d8: The perreo and dembow temple reinvests Frigo 16 with Latin Addict.
en|9c0fd376875e: La Zona De Perreo returns to Frigo 16 for a special Christmas edition at high temperature. Come vibe to the best reggaeton, dembow and shatta mixed by the resident DJs of the collective in a newly redecorated 109. The meetup runs from 8 p.m. to 2 a.m. to celebrate the year‑end holidays. Pre‑sales start at 12 euros on Shotgun.
en|a5029d66ceef: Elegant house set by Karl Zen K in the cosy vibe of Mama Shelter.
en|e30db5e0a8f8: Mama Shelter Nice invites Karl Zen K, an experienced Riviera DJ who has shared the stage with Bob Sinclar or Moojo. He takes the decks to serve a festive mix of house, nu‑disco and tech house from 8:30 p.m. to 12:30 a.m. The friendly atmosphere of the Nice spot is perfect for kicking off the weekend. Entry is completely free with recommended reservation.
en|1d6f67d1e29e: Festive year‑end house party with Les Bonnes Franquettes.
en|9cc0466197b3: The collective Les Bonnes Franquettes gathers its community for a big Christmas celebration at La Séguinière. Find an energetic selection of house, tech house and electro house curated by the collective’s DJs and their guests. Warm and festive vibes start at 8:30 p.m. in this bucolic hinterland venue. Admission is 16.50 euros.
en|77cf9a2e7bdd: Live acidcore and new generation tekno with producer Wado at L'Antre.
en|789b57e84b77: Producer and DJ Wado from Mojo Crew takes over L'Antre for a wild set blending acidcore, mentalcore and melodic tekno with a supercharged vibe. Come lose yourself in the analog TB-303 bass lines on the Martin Audio sound system. Meet from 10:00 pm to 2:00 am in Vieux‑Nice. Pre‑sales are available at €5.99 on Shotgun.
en|68eaab1ebcab: Last shatta and bouyon party before Christmas with the SHAFRO crew at Factory.
en|6d9b77087d88: Third Toulon round for the SHAFRO tour at Factory La Farlède just before the end‑of‑year holidays. DJ Abi and SEG Agency residents take the reins to make you sweat to pure shatta, afrobeats and bouyon. The event runs from 8:00 pm to 2:00 am to celebrate the start of the holidays. Tickets start at €7.99 on the ticketing platform.
en|57e902d67ed3: Free soul, funk and old‑school RnB vibes after Christmas in Nice.
en|fbb23f1bdce7: Mama Shelter Nice hosts Nico Pac for a warm Saturday night amid the end‑of‑year celebrations. The Nice DJ will share his best selections mixing soul, funk, old‑school RnB and catchy house touches. Enjoy the bar‑restaurant setting to have a drink and dance from 8:30 pm to 12:30 am. The event is free and open entry.
en|96d5dd2c776a: Huge outdoor New Year’s Eve with DJ sets, dancers and LED robot show in Fréjus.
en|effc4c092c95: Celebrate the 2027 transition outdoors with Fréjus’s big New Year’s Eve on Place Formigé. Live DJs, professional dancers and performers with futuristic LED robot shows line up from 6:00 pm to 2:00 am. A big sound system and festive visuals set the night for the new year. The event is free and open to all.
en|4983ce9159e1: New Year’s Eve evening with champagne and special menu
en|449123ff48b1: Fireworks at midnight and DJ atmosphere on the quays of Saint‑Tropé port.
en|98e1388a3805: Head to the quays of Saint‑Tropé port to celebrate New Year’s Eve by the water. Open‑format music and DJs set the evening from 6:30 pm before the traditional pyrotechnic show at exactly midnight over the bay. The vibe continues late into the night on Quai Suffren. The gathering is entirely free and open.
en|1b24a7060383: Electro New Year’s Eve on December 31 signed by Aztek and Club Sonore on the seaside.
en|1c1bedf95dd7: Aztek and Club Sonore collectives team up to bring the 2027 transition to Playa Chica. The beach venue is equipped with a reinforced sound system and a fairy‑tale scenography for a night of house, afro‑house and tech house until dawn. Festivities begin at 7:00 pm with a required New Year’s Eve dress code. Access guaranteed by pre‑registration via the ticketing platform.
en|f6ad5416749c: Celebrate New Year's Eve on December 31st in the VIP lounges of Allianz Riviera.
en|981ddf3def5e: The Frenchy pre‑party settles into the lounge areas of Allianz Riviera Stadium for New Year’s. Program: festive DJ set dedicated to French classics and popular hits, live karaoke, photobox, and midnight countdown under sequins and glitter. Meet from 7:30 pm to 1:30 am to celebrate the arrival of 2027 in a unique setting.
en|c9a172eef7ba: Masked and retro New Year’s Eve in the heart of a palace on the Promenade des Anglais.
en|cca3bd854aea: Spend New Year’s at the prestigious Hyatt Regency Palais de la Méditerranée on a masquerade theme. The resident DJs of La compil revisit the biggest anthems from the ’90s and 2000s, from Britney Spears to Rihanna via Black Eyed Peas. A drink is included with the entrance ticket. The party is for adults only, from 8 pm to 2 am, masks recommended.
en|73406bf9a1d8: New Year’s theme Roaring Twenties and Prohibition by the sea at Casino de Beaulieu.
en|f42e320e12d9: Celebrate the arrival of 2027 in the Belle Époque Salon of Casino de Beaulieu with a chic Prohibition New Year’s. Dress in Roaring Twenties or Peaky Blinders attire to enjoy performers before switching to house and nu‑disco clubbing with Enzo Trulli and JT. The midnight countdown promises a grand celebration until 5 am. Clubbing tickets start at €25.
en|babda70bcd9f: Zelli’s Club sets up at AREV for a chic and festive New Year’s until dawn.
en|7c306965d26a: For New Year’s Eve, the legendary Zelli’s Club takes over the AREV Saint‑Tropez hotel. The evening features live music and resident DJ sets for a house, deep house, and nu‑disco atmosphere from 8 pm until the early morning. The setting is upscale and very elegant dress is required at entry. Access is exclusively by reservation with the venue.

Più di 50 musicisti e artisti si susseguono sul palco dal vivo e in mix per far ballare il pubblico. Bar aperitivo e ristorazione con pizze sono previsti sul posto dalle 19:00 alle 23:30. I posti sono accessibili a partire da 15 € per questa grande serata retro coperta.

es|28ff21b189bd: Pasa tu noche de Año Nuevo en Jimmy'z con la leyenda del disco Cerrone y el crew TANTRÜM.
es|5b99884aefad: Para dar la bienvenida al 2027, Jimmy'z Monte-Carlo se asocia con el colectivo house TANTRÜM para una noche de clubbing excepcional. Como cabeza de cartel, encontrarás al pionero mundial del disco y de la French Touch Cerrone con un set DJ en vivo exclusivo hasta la madrugada. Prepárate para un mix contundente entre disco, house y afro house en uno de los clubs más reputados del Rocher. La fiesta arranca a las 22:00, preventa a partir de 55 euros en Shotgun y vestimenta chic obligatoria.
es|41549abf138b: Pasa la noche de Año Nuevo al ritmo de house y tech house en Glass Club.
es|da1934bf01b5: Dirígete al Carré d'Or en Cannes para celebrar el año nuevo en el club house por excelencia. Ambre Ballester y Ugo Puccinelli se unen en B2B para una noche completa de house y tech house groovy de 22:00 a 07:00. Cócteles de lujo y pista de baile ardiendo para celebrar el 2027. Preventa recomendada a partir de 15,99 euros.
es|708c3660a211: La noche de Año Nuevo mítica del Mas d'Hiver para celebrar el paso al 2027.
es|b6a627e75bed: Mas d'Hiver saca la gran jugada para cerrar el año en Puget-sur-Argens, a un paso de Fréjus. Los DJs residentes preparan un set electro, house y bangers clubbing para bailar toda la noche en un ambiente festivo y sobrecargado. Bares interiores y terraza climatizada en el programa desde las 22:00. Precio de preventa para estudiantes a partir de 30,20 euros.
es|c310949aa6de: Noche XXL y after de hard techno con Je Dis Techno en KOSMA.
es|5db4fdb2c1d3: La institución de los jueves niçois Je Dis Techno pasa a modo gigante para la noche de Año Nuevo en KOSMA. Ven a recibir el 2027 en el sótano con ritmos hard techno y acid techno sin concesiones, con after programado para los más temerarios. El disparo de salida es a las 23:00 para una comunión rave underground. Preventas disponibles desde 12,99 euros.
es|75d7f4b518a4: Pasa la noche de Año Nuevo en la playa de Cannes con un show de drones gigante.
es|a7eb75280e99: Reúne a tus colegas en la Croisette para celebrar la llegada del nuevo año junto al mar. La ciudad de Cannes propone un espectáculo grandioso que combina ballet de drones y gran espectáculo de fuegos artificiales sincronizado con una banda sonora electro‑pop inspirada en el cine. La cita es libre y gratuita desde las 23:30 para brindar a medianoche en la playa antes de seguir la noche en los clubs canoenses.
es|c39650cedc42: El mega show revival de los 80 para cantar éxitos retro en el Zénith.
es|51be1e0d558b: La gira fenómeno RFM Party 80 celebra sus 20 años en el Zénith de Toulon con un escenario que reúne a los cantantes icónicos de la década. Aunque el evento apunta a un público más amplio, la atmósfera de karaoke gigante y disfraces retro también atrae a jóvenes en busca de una fiesta de segunda intención. El show arranca a las 20:00 con entradas a partir de 35 euros.
